description: Line 1375: let subject = GeneralName::DirectoryName(cert.tbs_certificate.subject.clone()). This clones the entire subject DN to wrap it in GeneralName for use in name_matches_subtree comparisons. The clone exists only because name_matches_subtree takes &GeneralName by reference. The DN is owned by the certificate and lives for the duration of chain_walk; a borrow would suffice. However GeneralName wraps an owned Name, so constructing a GeneralName::DirectoryName without cloning would require either restructuring name_matches_subtree to accept Name separately for the DirectoryName case, or making the function take a reference. For no_std this is an avoidable heap allocation per certificate during NC check.
title: GeneralName::DirectoryName clone in check_name_constraints is unnecessary
